title: Our Early Access Journey Is Coming to an End | RuneScape: Dragonwilds - 1.0 Update
author: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
description:
After 17 months of building RuneScape: Dragonwilds alongside our community, 1.0 is almost here.

Join our JMods as they take you through the journey so far, the content coming up with our 1.0 update and the journey ahead.

Coming September 15, 2026 on Steam, PS5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, the Epic Games Store and Jagex Launcher. Also available - day 1 with XBOX Game Pass (Premium, Ultimate) and PlayStation Plus (Extra, Premium).

transcript.text: RuneScape Dragonwild’s early access journey is coming to an end. Since we first opened the gates to Ashenfall
more than 1.5 million of you have joined us. You've explored every corner, built incredible worlds,
faced down multiple dragons and occasionally broken the game in ways that surprised even us. Throughout this journey,
your feedback has helped shape Dragonwilds into what it is today. So from all of us here at Jagex
thank you so much for your support, your trust, and your passion.
With every update, the continent of Ashenfall has grown more alive, and with it, even greater dangers have emerged.
Now the greatest threat of all awaits, Kuldra the Dragon Queen. Today we're taking you through our 1.0 update,
Scorned Wilderness. But wait! Hold your dragons. Before we look ahead, let's look back to how we got here. Deep breath.
Here we go. In April 2025, we shadow dropped Dragonwilds into early access, a few weeks after we teased its existence,
and it surpassed our expectations and cemented us as a Steam top seller. We were really doing it!
And your feedback came flooding in. In the months that followed,
we focused on strengthening the foundations of the game,
and introduced the magic and ranged skill, each with their own skill spells.
After receiving so many requests, we also added creative and custom modes,
giving you the freedom to experience Dragonwilds at your own pace.
And then in December, we released Fellhollow, our first major update,
which took you into a brand new region consumed by death, wither and rot.
It brought the steel tier, mounts, new enemies and farming. We carried that momentum into 2026 and made you a promise.
Monthly updates with more content between our major releases and we delivered a range of quests and activities,
including spectral platforming, X marks the spot, Cook’s Assistant and repeatable
Letters for the Dead for you to live out your Postie Pete fantasies... No, not like that.
We ran our first community art contest and Suizzyowl took the top spot.
If you're joining us on console for the very first time, that cape
you'll be able to craft was made by one of our very own community members. Enjoy! In March, Dowdun Reach
led you deep into Zamorakian territory through a fortress collapsing into chaos.
A different kind of challenge that pushed you to Mithril gear,
Mystic Robes and threw you into a clash with the Black Knight Titan. We added support for dedicated servers too.
Then in June, Umbral Sands took you to a scorching desert, our largest region to date.
You were introduced to Adamant Tier, and new game modes such as the Fight Cave and the Nightmare Crucible.
With the Nightmare Crucible, we equipped you to finally upgrade your vestige and Masterwork gear
and weapons, including the Granite Maul for the toughest end-game challenges.
Since launch we have added some of RuneScape’s most iconic skills,
including farming, fishing and agility, while expanding
more skills through to level 99 and adding new skill capes to earn.
We've improved controller support, made movement and jumping more responsive,
and continued refining combat to give you greater control in every fight.
And of course, we introduced new building pieces and decorations.
We have loved seeing the incredible bases, settlements, and in some cases, entire
townships you've created. To catch up on everything we have added since launch, be sure to visit our blog.
Before jumping into the action with the launch of 1.0, we are making some core improvements across the entire game.
The building system has received a major optimisation work. You will notice a massive reduction in building load times
and improved performance in dense building areas. We've also made a wide range of changes to make combat feel
faster, smoother and more responsive. Let's take a closer look. You can now do sprint attacks.
Successful parries will restore 50% of your maximum stamina and allow you to land a single, brutal attack;
dealing extra damage. Stamina costs for blocking and attacking have been rebalanced.
You will also be able to interrupt a whole slew of combat animations
in melee combat, magic and ranged, as well as your skill spells, allowing you to snap back into the action quickly.
You will notice earlier block windows and improve damage telegraphing, and the special bar has been added to.
We are adding new mini bosses and nine enemy variations to Brynmore, Ghornfell, Fellhollow and Dowden Reach,
who will attack you in their own unique ways using poison, burn shock and wither rot.
So use that cauldron and brew some defensive pots to defend yourself. That's not all.
With the 1.0 update, we're introducing a new magic weapon type, Wands!
Wands will offer you a more mobile and faster paced way to cast magic damage
from all three elemental types, air, fire and water. All of these changes have been added to give you more control
for the challenges ahead. Useful. You're going to need them! Now, are we ready for Kuldra?
Kuldra, the God eater herself. The five headed dragon Queen has been the ultimate threat,
looming over Ashenfall from the very beginning. Long ago, the Dragon Kin built the harmonic resonator to harness
Ashenfall’s wild Anima. Using its power, they created Kuldra
as their ultimate weapon, pushing her to the brink of divinity.
But when the Dragon Kin destroyed her children, Kuldra turned against her creators, and devoured them.
In a desperate attempt to stop her, the harmonic resonator was shattered, tearing Ashenfall apart, but Kuldra survived.
Now she is gathering the scattered remnants of the resonator to unleash another cataclysm.
One powerful enough to consume all of Gielinor. That means no more Runecrafting Guild, no more lovingly
built house you spent ages on or not... No more anything. With the world at risk, Saradomin has sent Commander Zilyana
to Ashenfall in search of champions capable of stopping the Dragon Queen. I think that's you. Is that them?
Yeah. It's you right? Unlike our previous major updates, Scorned Wilderness isn't another expansive region to explore.
At the heart of the update is the Scorned Wilderness raid,
a gauntlet you can take on alone, or alongside your fellow adventurers. They say your life flashes before your eyes
when you're close to death. The road to Kuldra offers something uncomfortably similar.
Fragments of a place you have already visited are pulled into a fractured landscape, like memories of the past.
It's a challenge that will test you against everything you've learned on your journey.
From humble adventurer to dragon slayer, Torn apart by wild anima and the fury of black dragons,
you will traverse these floating islands as you fight for every foothold
and push further to earn the right to face Kuldra. Along the way, her elemental heads will put you to the test
in smaller skirmishes. The odds are against you. But you wouldn't be here if you understood the odds ay!
Scorned Wilderness also introduces the next tier of progression. Runite!
You will gather resources to craft new gear such as Rune armor,
Ancestral Robes, and Black Dragon hide armor, giving you a better chance
to rise to the challenge and meet Kuldra head, or heads on... It's hard to keep track.
1.0 also completes the remaining skill progression tracks through level 99 with new unlocks, carrying your journey
all the way into the end game. And finally, with 1.0, we're opening the gates to more adventurers than ever before.
You know what we're talking about. For the first time in our 25 year history, a RuneScape game is coming to console.
The complete 1.0 experience, including everything we've delivered throughout early access,
will be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2,
and of course on PC. With cross-play available across all platforms,
adventurers can explore, build and battle together wherever they choose to play.
Dragonwilds will also be available day one for PlayStation
Plus Extra and Premium members, as well as Xbox Game Pass members.
For our collectors, physical editions for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X
will follow on the 5th of November, which you can preorder now. One to make room for on the shelf.
Shipping 1.0 is a huge milestone for us. It will bring Kuldra’s saga to an end
as players enter the Scorned Wilderness raid and finally defeat her. But the end of Kuldra's story is not the end
of RuneScape Dragonwilds. Ashenfall will continue to grow.
There are more stories to tell and many more adventures ahead. So how about a little sneak peek?
First up coming this winter is Luminance, our next major update.
This will be a free update introducing the prayer skill and a new material tier.
You will meet new characters, uncover a growing conflict and bag yourself an all new building kit.
Beyond that, we will continue to deliver our free monthly updates
beyond launch and into 2027, bringing you new quests, activities,
rewards, and quality of life improvements shaped by your feedback. Just like we've done throughout Early Access.
And that's also going to be complemented by a larger story, our next saga, that will bring new
skills, quests, regions, bosses, enemies, and rewards as we continue our adventure
into this unexplored stretch of the Sixth Age and beyond. Soon we will have more to share, but for now, a name.
The Blood Crystal Saga. We're so excited for the future, and we can't wait
for you to catch us live at RuneFest, where we will reveal more. To everyone who joined us during early access,
shared feedback and help shape Dragonwilds... Thank you. We would not be here without you.
We're incredibly proud of how far Dragonwilds has come and everything we've built together so far.
Across the world, we're seeing adventurers new and old answer the call. Whether you're a veteran RuneScape player
or you're jumping into Dragonwilds for the first time... Welcome home. We're thrilled to share this journey with you
as we continue to grow Dragonwilds in the years to come. And this is just the beginning.
We'll see you in Ashenfall adventurers.
